name: Deviled Kidneys
description: Historical recipe from The Canadian Family Cook Book (1914). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: One quart of water or stock
ingredients.originalText: One quart of water or stock
ingredients.quantityText: One quart of water or stock

instructions.text: Cut the kidneys in thin round slices
Cover them with cold water and let stand half an hour
Wash them clean and put in stew-pan with one quart of water or stock, a clove, four teaspoonfuls of onion-juice, salt and pepper
Simmer two hours or longer if not tender
Set away, and for breakfast put one tablespoonful of butter in frying-pan
When hot add one tablespoonful of flour

source.author: Grace E. Denison
source.originalInstructions:
1. Cut the kidneys in thin round slices
2. Cover them with cold water and let stand half an hour
3. Wash them clean and put in stew-pan with one quart of water or stock, a clove, four teaspoonfuls of onion-juice, salt and pepper
4. Simmer two hours or longer if not tender
5. Set away, and for breakfast put one tablespoonful of butter in frying-pan
6. When hot add one tablespoonful of flour
7. Stir till brown and smooth
